name: crazycodeeditor
description: Paste into any Electron DevTools console: a portable Python IDE with a built-in interpreter.

scripts.experiment:csp: node tools/host-app/run-experiment.mjs csp-experiment.cjs && node tools/host-app/run-experiment.mjs csp-override-experiment.cjs
scripts.smoke:all: node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke && node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke --nodev && node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke --csp && node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke --cspheader && node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke --cspeval && node tools/host-app/run.mjs --smoke --node
